what_is_verified_locally: The selected CSV files were parsed, their dimensions and SHA-256 checksums recorded, and their detailed node universes were aligned.
what_is_not_independently_proven: Even a full companion-workbook scan cannot by itself prove which OECD download archive each individual CSV came from. Retain the original OECD download URL/archive or source manifest for file-level provenance.
official_reference_context: The OECD ICIO dataset page lists a 2025 regular ICIO release covering 1995-2022. This supports using 2019 and 2022 from that release in principle, but does not independently identify the provenance of these local CSV files.
